deferred_to_upstream.summary: Live dogfood's example-value resolver doesn't synthesize valid values for JSON-array/object-shaped flags or enum-constrained flags, so happy_path/json_fidelity fail with a placeholder-generated request the API was always going to reject.
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Pipeline-shaped (dogfood fixture generation), not an e-boekhouden defect. `mutation create --rows` and `mutation get-outstanding-invoices --cred-deb` both fail Phase 5 live testing purely because of the placeholder values the harness supplies, not the CLI's handling of real input. Tracked at https://github.com/mvanhorn/cli-printing-press/issues/4464.

deferred_to_upstream.summary: Live dogfood's error_path test assumes any command positional should reject a sentinel invalid value with a non-zero exit, but that doesn't hold for a free-text search positional not literally named <query>, a local-store lookup where "not found" is a valid empty result, or a raw API passthrough the upstream API itself doesn't validate.
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Pipeline-shaped (dogfood error_path classification), not an e-boekhouden defect. `mutation suggest <description>`, `relation statement <relation-id>`, and `swagger get <catchAll>` all fail Phase 5 live testing for correct, already-intentional exit-0 behavior. Tracked at https://github.com/mvanhorn/cli-printing-press/issues/4465.
